A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''bridge commander''' served aboard the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] during the murder investigation of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Tanith Shire]], concurrent with the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. This bridge officer alerted the ''Executor'' murder investigation team of a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents who had boarded the ''Executor'' masquerading as [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] looking to join [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] hunt for [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].
